text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Miles, miles, the mile is here!
Today's the fun-filled Victoria Mile~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the heat is cranked up to 160 miles an hour!
G1 miles really are the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but...
The atmosphere feels a bit...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Almond Eye is gonna win anyway.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even if she came from the Tiara route...
she's on a level where she should be taking on the world, right?
Why did she come over here?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Right? It's like she's on a totally different level... Well, she really looks like she wants to win, so maybe she came here to grab an easy victory.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Senpai Eye has got overwhelming praise!
Though I'm not so sure about the race reviews.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
There's a bit of an unpleasant vibe in the air...—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... And here I thought I wouldn't bump into anything anymore.
Why did this...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
“—I don't want to run anymore...
Ai-san is just going to win anyway...”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
............
"Ai-san's gonna win anyway," huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Could be, I guess—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood the reaction of those around us. It was because of her overwhelming strength, which I also trusted in—
but I would never let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's start the meeting.
What should we be most careful of today?
choice_data_list: That's Lucky Lilac's move, all right.
That's Lucky Lilac's move, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I agree!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the Shuka Sho,
that girl's training...
had become even more intense, after all."
choice_data_list: Yeah, and also... are you feeling all right?
Yeah, and also... are you feeling all right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Health?
Why do you ask?
choice_data_list: Because it hasn't been that long since the "Osaka Hai"...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's not a problem at all!
I'm totally fine and full of energy!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I feel like I've got energy to burn!
Races really do give me strength, after all."
choice_data_list: If that's the case, then that's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I check on her condition each time, and regular checkups haven't shown any problems.
She certainly seems fine, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay!
If anything happens, you'll notice it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So it's okay for me to give it everything I've got.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: In that case, today I'll give it my all—and win!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah...!!
Almond Eyyyyyyyyyye!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Her popularity is as insane as ever, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san. Mind if I ask ya one thing?
Why'd you pick this race today?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "You could've used this time to recharge... and aimed to peak around the Yasuda Kinen or Takarazuka Kinen instead."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why?!
Here, of all places—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I have you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You've built up more muscle than before, haven't you?
And it's well-balanced, too...
You really have gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—You're completely different from how you were before!
It's the you right now that I want to beat!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...You're still saying things like that to me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I guess... I'm still your rival after all...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――... Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry 'bout that... It's just,
what you're sayin' hasn't changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're strong. Voices around you,
changes in your environment... none of it affects you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Even when everyone else is shaken,
Ai-san always stays true to herself."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Because you're true to your own feelings, you're standing right here right now—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks for givin' me such a great chance.
Thanks to you, I can finally beat ya.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
!
Fufu, see, you are confident after all!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Any thought of that was scattered by you. But—
on the turf, a single moment can flip everything upside down.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: During the Oka Sho, I was on the losing end. Your breakthrough after that goes without saying. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If you beat me, everyone's opinion of you will completely change—
that's why you want to win, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Your heart is truly wonderful!
No matter how many times I win, it never feels like I've defeated you at all...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —That's why no matter how many times it takes, I want to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Let's show each other everything
we've cultivated since that day!"
